guideline: Body text must meet at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background. Large text (>=18pt or >=14pt bold) must meet at least 3:1.
All interactive touch targets on touchscreens or for young students must measure at least 44x44px (or 48x48px) with at least 8px spacing between adjacent targets.
Headings must always carry at least 2x more whitespace above them than below them to unambiguously bind to the section they introduce.
Paragraph text reading widths must be constrained between 65 and 75 characters (max-w-prose or max-width: 68ch) to prevent ocular fatigue.
All columns containing numbers, prices, times, dates, or student codes must use tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for vertical alignment.
Always use skeleton screens or pre-allocated bounding dimensions for images/cards to achieve Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) = 0.
Never show a blank white page when a list is empty. Provide an icon, friendly explanation, and a direct primary action (e.g. 'Create your first course').
Validation errors must sit directly below the offending input field, highlighted with a red border, an error icon, and specific plain-language guidance to resolve the issue.
Never use unstyled raw gray (#888) text on a colored or tinted surface. The secondary text must be tinted with the surface hue to prevent dirty optical artifacts.
Every interactive control must display a visible, high-contrast focus ring when focused via keyboard (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2).
